plugins.name: ccmemo
plugins.description: Persist knowledge and plans across Claude Code sessions. Provides /record-knowledge, /plan-task, and /review-knowledge skills with Sonnet subagent delegation.

plugins.name: ccresmon
plugins.description: Claude Code resource monitor hook. Checks memory/CPU before Agent spawn and disk I/O before Bash execution.

plugins.name: ccevolve
plugins.description: Self-improving workflow for Claude Code. Enforces Knowledge-First Flow, detects recurring errors, and manages domain-specific rules.

plugins.name: ccorch
plugins.description: Orchestration plugin for Claude Code. Subagent-default hybrid: model-routed agent catalog, spawn gate + ledger hooks, /ccor-parallel worktree fan-out, and /ccor tmux panes for cross-repo work.

plugins.name: ccaudit
plugins.description: Record and preserve audit trails of AI-assisted work so humans can verify and attest. Provides automatic Stop-hook flush to a remote trail repository plus /audit-flush for manual inspection.

plugins.name: ccguard
plugins.description: Deterministic PreToolUse guards for Claude Code. The first guard blocks git commits that carry AI/assistant attribution or session metadata.
